name: com.openmobilehub.android.auth.plugin.google.nongms.presentation.redirect.RedirectActivity
description: When the app uses Open Mobile Hub's Google sign-in flow without Google Play services, this Activity opens a browser sign-in page and receives the identity provider's return. It then passes the sign-in result back to the app.
disableEffect: Users on this sign-in path cannot complete Google login, so the app may not accept their account.
